summary: A migration audit found four candidate named rulings in continuity context, but no authoritative source for a six-ruling list. Migration is blocked against invention until the governing source is supplied or Dan corrects the expected count.

Confirmed all three captures are marked captured_not_reviewed and once_snapshot_visible_only, so they are source artifacts rather than approved truth.
open_items: Locate the source containing RECORD-5 and RECORD-6, if those rulings exist.
